reopen_assumption: When the retry toggle is on, this page treats 25% of resolved tickets as a second billable event. That 25% is this page's assumption, not a vendor statistic. It is applied only where a published rule bills the new event.

intercom.notes: Fin outcomes are $0.99. A return to the same conversation is not charged. Standalone Fin has no seat fee and a 50-outcome monthly minimum. With Intercom, the Essential plan is $29 per seat per month on annual billing and at least one full seat is required. A monthly Essential seat price was not in that FAQ extract, so this row prices the annual seat.

zendesk.notes: Suite Team is $55 per agent per month billed annually or $69 monthly, with 5 automated resolutions per agent each month. Suite Professional is $115 annually or $149 monthly, with 10. Extra resolutions are $1.50 committed or $2.00 pay-as-you-go. Copilot is $50 per agent per month paid yearly on Professional and higher. A reopen rule was not on the pricing page, so the retry toggle does not add Zendesk outcomes.

tidio.notes: The free 50 Lyro conversations are one-time and do not renew, so they are not subtracted from a monthly bill. The official pricing page shows annual entry at $32.50 per month for the starting pack (two months free) and says a new thread after inactivity counts again. The monthly pack ladder above is the public calculator's published steps; above 1,000 conversations the page says contact sales, so this row stays unpriced.

customgpt.notes: Standard is $99 per month with 1,000 queries. Premium is $499 per month with 5,000 queries. There is no per-resolution fee. Extra queries are $375 per month for 2,500. A customer reply counts as another query when the retry toggle is on.

enterprise.notes: Ada and Sierra do not publish a per-resolution list price. Third-party contract write-ups are not used as a bill. This row stays unpriced so a quote can be compared with the self-serve totals.
